schedule.label: owner must pay contractor (holdback)
schedule.basis: lien period (60) + owner has 14 days to pay after expiry — up to 74 days from the event with no preserved lien

schedule.label: contractor passes down (if paid on the due date)
schedule.basis: 14 days after receipt to pay downstream parties

schedule.label: holdback to retain (amount, not a date)
schedule.basis: CAD 80,000.00 x 10% = CAD 8,000.00 retained. The statute applies the rate to the price of the services or materials supplied; you chose the base (check with your accountant or lawyer whether tax is in it). Rounded half-up to the cent (the rounding rule is not stated in the text we read - unverified).

disclaimer: Administrative reminder, not legal advice - verify with counsel.
applicability: Contracts/procurements that started before July 1, 2018 stay under the old Act (Construction Act s.87.3(1)).
Prompt-payment and adjudication Parts do not apply to contracts entered into before Oct 1, 2019 (Construction Act s.87.3(4)).
